decisions.reason: As a newly launched multi-model range with its own page, this product reflects visible commitment and investment in the firm's portfolio expansion, so management is likely to continue it.
This supplement was publicly launched on its own page and fits the firm's consumer-health broadening, making withdrawal within a year unlikely despite limited early evidence.
